description: This file defines a Roslyn code fix provider for the Orleans.Analyzers project. It provides automatic code fixes for diagnostics related to generating serialization attributes, including generating [GenerateSerializer], [Id(x)], and [NonSerialized] attributes on class members.

classes.name: GenerateOrleansSerializationAttributesCodeFix
classes.description: A code fix provider implementation that offers fixes for diagnostics related to serialization attribute generation in Orleans projects.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Registers code fixes for diagnostics found in the analyzed document, offering options like generating serialization attributes or adding [GenerateSerializer] attributes.

methods.name: AddGenerateSerializerAttribute
methods.description: Adds the [GenerateSerializer] attribute to a type declaration.

methods.name: AddSerializationAttributes
methods.description: Adds [Id(x)] attributes to unannotated members of a type based on analysis.

methods.name: AddNonSerializedAttributes
methods.description: Adds [NonSerialized] attributes to unannotated members and ensures the 'System' namespace is imported.
